description: Integza's videos center on ambitious DIY engineering projects, most often building and testing small-scale rocket engines, unusual propulsion systems, and other mechanical devices using 3D printing and machining. The host, a mechanical engineer, approaches these experiments with humor and transparency, frequently showing failures, unexpected explosions, and the trial-and-error process alongside successful ignitions. Beyond rockets, he also tackles oddball builds like a shotgun-powered axe or modified combustion devices, always blending genuine technical explanation with chaotic experimentation.
